nom: Vichy Neovadiol Elixir Oil Face Serum, 1.01 Fl. Oz.

avis.texte: This "Elixir Face Oil" is, well, oily. I am not new to facial oils, but I find that this one by Vichy is not easily absorbed. It stays on the skin. Even when i apply the oil at night, I can see the remnants of it the next morning. If you have very dry, parched skin on your face, perhaps this is a good product for you. Otherwise, it's probably not necessary.

I've been using this facial oil for several years, but haven't been able to locate it recently at my local CVS. I was so happy that I was able to purchase this on Amazon. At first I was a little nervous that this would not be an authentic product, but I can assure you that it is! The bottle has been updated but the product is the same as the formula I've been using for years. I have sensitive, eczema-prone skin, and like to use this on my face to enhance hydration (particularly during the winter). A little goes a long way, and it only takes a few drops to really cover your whole face. It is lightly scented, but I find the scent really appealing and soothing. For deeper hydration, I mix this with my night cream.

Vichy serum is worth every penny. You can use it alone or with your moisturizer. It’s really improve the texture of my skin over the last few months. The first post menopausal product I found that works .

Best face oil around for my own skin situation. I believe this oil helped clear up my rosacea. It is so sheer that it soaks into your skin in seconds and smells wonderful! Thank you for providing a great product and it was wrapped with care. ❤️

avis.titre: Not My Favorite Vichy Product (4- Stars)
avis.texte: This oil works well to moisturize and protect my face, but I'm not wild about its application and the initial oily feel. You put a few drops of oil on your fingertips, and gently rub into your skin. Yes, it absorbs fairly quickly. But yes, it's a thin oil that can drip between your fingers before it makes it to your face. I've discovered that it's better to do one drop at a time to cover a single area before moving on. I love the effects of this oil serum. I just don't like the medium. -- Debbie Lee Wesselmann
The best facial oil I have tried! I will but again. Note: I have VERY dry skin.
Il prodotto è indicato per pelli mature e nel corso degli anni ho trovato che questo è uno dei più validi. Non adatto a chi non vuole sentire unto sul viso.
Ottimo olio per il viso, soddisfa le mie esigenze, amo il prodotto che lascia il viso idratato per molto tempo; non consigliato per chi non ama il viso unto

avis.titre: Comforts My Dry Skin & Makes It Look Dewy & Healthy-Leaves An Oily Shimmer But Still Works w/ Makeup
avis.texte: Vichy Neovadiol is a face oil that comes in a dropper bottle. I’m in my 50’s and have uncomfortably dry skin. I’ve been using this oil on my face and neck at least a few times a week (sometimes more) for about a month, and at this rate the product will last many months. At night, I apply the oil generously (almost a full dropper) and use it like a “leave on” mask. I get a slight warming feel when I first apply the oil. The warmth subsides and my skin feels well moisturized and comfortable all night. My skin absorbs most of the product, but I do wake with a slight oily residue and my skin feels soft and supple. I don’t notice oil on my pillowcase, though I’m largely a back sleeper. I also use this Vichy Neovadiol oil during the day like a serum after cleansing well. I use just a few drops and afterwards I apply my day cream with an SPF. My skin absorbs most of the oil, but I still see and feel a light shimmer of oil by the time I need to put on my face cream and makeup to get ready for work. I just go ahead and apply my face cream, and any residual oil blends in with my cream. My skin ends up looking dewy and healthy, but not oily, and I have no issues applying my makeup. I find the fragrance really light, which is a good thing as fragrance can bother me. I would prefer a pump to a dropper, but the oil is relatively thin so I can see why a dropper bottle is used. I wouldn’t suggest this for oily skin, but I love it for my dry skin. 5 stars.

I adore the Vichy skincare line and have had wonderful results from their products, so I was excited to receive this Neovadiol Elizer Oil. It’s a little more pricey than some of their products. Vichy has quality products that won’t break my budget; however, this one, and a few others, do cost a little more. A little of this oil goes a long way though! The bottle is amber—it’s nice enough to sit on your bathroom countertop—but the oil inside is actually clear. It’s not a super thick oil. The scent is very very light—it smells good but it’s not strong at all and disappears quickly once the oil absorbs. Just a little is all your need to smooth over your face. It glides on and at first seems as if it will be oily but if you massage it in, it absorbs into the skin very well. My skin feels amazing after using this oil, but then I have yet to have a bad experience with Vichy! If I could, I’d have every product in their beauty arsenal! If you have skin that’s oily and prone to breakouts, this may not be for you. Combination, or aging skin, as I have, will drink it up. I also have sensitive skin and this, and all the Vichy products I’ve tried, has never irritated my skin. I’m super happy with it! Lovely oil face serum that I’ll use as a supplement to my skincare. I’d likely use this about an hour before bed, or if I use it during the day, it would be when I’m not wearing any makeup. Every woman has their skepticism whenever a product claims to reverse the aging effects. However this product actually works. It takes about a week to see real results but you'll feel them the first 2 days. Your skin will feel softer, lighter, plumper as well. After a week you'll begin to see these feelings as well, your skin will be more illuminating, lighter, a bit plumper. You can use this in 3 ways, you can either use one drop a day, a few drops added to your daily routine moisturizer or several drops for an intense facial. It comes with a dropper that you squeeze to to absorb from bottle then dispense on your face. I would recommend this product to anyone looking to rejuvenate their skin. The price is fair for the results you get.
Im noticing a VERY slight difference. I don't like the applicator, and the instructions are on the inside of the box! I'm not very impressed!
